entities.name: Ángel Federico Robledo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángel Federico Robledo was an Argentine politician, who occupied several posts during the presidencies of Juan Perón, Héctor José Cámpora, and Isabel Perón, such as Minister of Defense, Minister of Foreign Relationships, and Minister of Interior. He also served as Argentine Ambassador to Ecuador, Mexico and Brazil in different periods.
